system_description.narrative_title: Middle East escalation strains global energy, shipping and aviation
system_description.narrative_summary: A surge in attacks tied to Iran-aligned actors (notably Houthi strikes on Saudi infrastructure and shipping) has elevated regional military confrontation into a global shock, driving oil prices higher, disrupting shipping lanes and forcing aviation/security responses. Concurrent policy moves (sanctions waivers, shifts in oil flows) and investor retrenchment (postponed Saudi conference, market hedging) are interacting with humanitarian strains to produce systemic volatility across markets, logistics and diplomacy.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: abstract systemic variables — supply disruption risk, price volatility, chokepoint insecurity, escalation dynamics, sanction regime flexibility, market sentiment, insurance/premia and humanitarian access; concrete entities and assets — Houthis, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Israel, US, Russia, oil producers, refiners, tankers, airports, airlines, NATO/UK/coalition military assets, WFP and Gazan population; near-term dated events/catalysts — recent Houthi attacks on Saudi targets and shipping, diversion of flights/bomb threats, sinking of cargo ships near the Strait of Hormuz, Trump's sanctions waiver and postponement of 'Davos in the Desert'.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic order — international security interlinked with energy markets, trade flows and finance
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets, refining and strategic petroleum reserves
International maritime security and trade chokepoints (Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea)
Aviation security, commercial air travel and insurance/airspace management
Humanitarian aid and displacement operations in conflict-affected regions
evidence_headlines: Airport attacks put aviation in crosshairs of geopolitical conflicts
Oil hits five-month high of $110 on new escalation in Middle East
Iran Is Giving Houthis Targeting and Intelligence for Attacks on Saudi Arabia
Two Cargo Ships Sink Near Strait of Hormuz, as Iranian Attacks Increase
Saudi Arabia postpones its 'Davos in the Desert' conference after Houthi attacks
Trump Waives Sanctions Against Russia Just Before New Law Takes Effect

variables.name: Supply disruption risk
variables.description: Measures the probability and expected severity of interruptions to energy and critical goods supplies across trade routes.

variables.name: Price volatility
variables.description: Measures the magnitude of short-term fluctuations in commodity and financial asset prices.

variables.name: Chokepoint insecurity
variables.description: Measures the threat level and incidence of hostile actions or interdictions at geographically constrained maritime and air passages.

variables.name: Escalation dynamics
variables.description: Measures the rate of increase or decrease in hostile actions, retaliatory measures, and militarized incidents in the region.

variables.name: Sanctions flexibility
variables.description: Measures the degree to which restrictive economic measures are being relaxed, waived, tightened, or otherwise adjusted.

variables.name: Market sentiment
variables.description: Measures collective investor confidence, risk appetite, and positioning in response to geopolitical and economic signals.

variables.name: Insurance premia level
variables.description: Measures prevailing costs for war-risk, hull, and liability insurance for maritime and aviation operators serving the region.

variables.name: Humanitarian access
variables.description: Measures the ability of aid actors to deliver food, medical supplies and services to affected civilian populations.

variables.name: Shipping delay rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and average duration of delays and reroutings in maritime cargo movements due to security or logistical disruption.

variables.name: Aviation disruption rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which flights are diverted, canceled, or face security incidents affecting commercial air traffic.

variables.name: Freight rate level
variables.description: Measures prevailing charter and freight rates for bulk, tanker and container shipping reflecting demand, risk and capacity.

variables.name: Strategic oil inventory levels
variables.description: Measures volumes of stored petroleum available across strategic and commercial reserves to buffer temporary supply shocks.

variables.name: Capital flow volatility
variables.description: Measures variability in cross-border investment flows, portfolio reallocations and short-term capital movements in response to risk.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, scale and intensity of diplomatic activity aimed at de-escalation, negotiation or alliance management.

variables.name: Military deployment intensity
variables.description: Measures the scale, concentration and operational readiness of armed forces and military assets deployed in or near the region.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the capacity of logistics networks and commercial systems to absorb disruptions, reroute flows and restore operations.

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi attacks on Saudi and regional targets
catalysts.description: Ongoing Houthi strikes on Saudi energy sites, airports and shipping lanes are likely to persist and expand in the near term. Continued attacks will directly pressure regional security, trade routes and markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthi attack kills 58...'; 'Houthi attacks on Saudi energy, airport sites'; 'Private jet charter costs from Saudi Arabia soar'.

catalysts.title: Allied defensive air and drone deployments expand
catalysts.description: UK, NATO and other partners are moving jets and drones to defend Saudi airspace and shipping approaches; deployments may broaden operational presence. This will change military posture and deterrence dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia'; 'NATO to send planes and drones to Black Sea'.

catalysts.title: U.S. decisions on waiving sanctions for shadow fleet/Russian fuel
catalysts.description: U.S. administration deliberations and waivers on sanctions for shadow-fleet and Russian fuel exports may be announced, altering trade flows and market risk pricing. Policy moves could reduce freight bottlenecks if implemented.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump weighs easing restrictions on Russian and Iranian ‘shadow fleet’'; 'Trump Waives Sanctions Against Russia...'.

catalysts.title: Sustained rerouting, smaller tankers and freight rate surge
catalysts.description: Refiners and shippers are shifting to smaller tankers and longer routes, keeping freight and charter rates elevated and prolonging logistical strain on crude and product flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Asian refiners use smaller tankers...'; 'Two Cargo Ships Sink Near Strait of Hormuz'.

catalysts.title: Spike in flight diversions, bomb threats and airport incidents
catalysts.description: Repeated diversions, bomb threats and airport attacks will continue to disrupt commercial air services to/from the region and push risk premiums for aviation higher.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Airport attacks put aviation in crosshairs'; 'Flight from Israel diverted after ‘threat’’; 'Austrian Airlines flight diverts'.

catalysts.title: WFP cuts reduce humanitarian access in Gaza
catalysts.description: World Food Programme aid reductions for half a million Palestinians will further constrain relief delivery and exacerbate humanitarian needs, affecting access and stability.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'World Food Programme cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza'; 'UN to cut food aid...'.

catalysts.title: Low U.S. strategic petroleum reserve pressures markets
catalysts.description: U.S. SPR stocks at multi-decade lows sustain price sensitivity to supply shocks and increase calls for policy responses or releases, keeping markets jittery.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Oil stocks in US strategic petroleum reserve fall to lowest level since 1982'.

catalysts.title: Investor withdrawals and postponement impacts from Saudi conference delay
catalysts.description: Postponement of Saudi investor conference and investor hesitation will depress capital inflows and create short-term reputational and sentiment headwinds for regional markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027'; 'Wall Street Elite Can’t Decide How to RSVP...'.

catalysts.title: Pakistan army chief's visit to Tehran
catalysts.description: An imminent high-level Pakistani military visit to Tehran could open channels for de‑escalation or coordination with Tehran, influencing regional diplomacy and conflict dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Pakistan army chief Asim Munir to visit Tehran on Tuesday'.
